component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.ke.operation
component.documentation: Registers AgenticKnowledgeEnrichment.Enrich, the Knowledge Enrichment operation backed by the Hyland CIC Java SDK (org.hyland.sdk:cic-ke). The Agentic UI calls it in place of the Content Intelligence Connector's HylandKnowledgeEnrichment.Enrich.
